knowledge_transfer.statement: The host/partners provide advanced agricultural data science, robust modelling, uncertainty analysis, hyperspectral/UAV/EO integration, precision-agriculture workflows and research-to-software/industry translation; the fellow provides the biological and experimental grounding. The transfer is genuinely complementary.

partner_contributions.heading: MATE -> FIELDWISE
partner_contributions.statement: MATE provides the heterogeneous 2022-2026 processing-tomato archive that makes processing tomato the development crop, together with experimental/irrigation knowledge, tomato plant material, trials, treatments, field measurements and agronomic information for primary validation.

partner_contributions.heading: ELTE -> FIELDWISE
partner_contributions.statement: ELTE provides the principal UAV, hyperspectral and geoinformatics capability for the spatial component: the instruments, the software environments and the scale-transition methodology bridging plant/plot observations to field-scale Sentinel-2 monitoring where pixel support is physically meaningful.

partner_contributions.heading: Krumatic -> FIELDWISE
partner_contributions.statement: Krumatic provides continuous software-development support from project start — incrementally improving the DrR prototype, implementing validated data/model functions and the crop-configurable architecture, migrating the validated core toward the web MVP — and later-stage Bulgarian farmer-facing dissemination and uptake. Distinct from AgroVIR's operational/FMIS evaluation function.

partner_contributions.heading: AgroVIR -> FIELDWISE
partner_contributions.statement: AgroVIR provides farm-management-software expertise and structured requirements consultation from the beginning of the project, and during M25-M30 the non-academic environment for formal operational evaluation of usability, data requirements, interoperability and future FMIS integration, designed so that protected/coded information is sufficient.

partner_contributions.heading: Commercial farmer site -> FIELDWISE
partner_contributions.statement: The independent commercial farmer site provides realistic crop husbandry and field-management conditions for prospective validation; FIELDWISE adds the required meteorological and soil-sensor infrastructure and retains responsibility for scientific measurements.

partner_contributions.heading: MVCRI -> FIELDWISE (post-MSCA)
partner_contributions.statement: MVCRI remains strategically important for subsequent replication under Bulgarian vegetable-production conditions and additional tomato material, joint publications, bilateral and European proposals, mobility and teaching — a post-MSCA route kept outside the core 24-month work plan to protect feasibility.

capacity_statements.heading: HUN-REN ATK - beneficiary/host
capacity_statements.statement: Primary supervision, modelling and data-integration environment through Dr. Roland Hollós, with access to the wider HUN-REN AI/data-processing infrastructure for computationally intensive analysis, and complementary plant-physiology expertise including Prof. Tibor Janda's Plant Physiology and Metabolomics Department at the Agricultural Institute.

capacity_statements.heading: ELTE - associated partner
capacity_statements.statement: Prof. András Jung and the Multisensor-Drone-Image Fusion research environment: geoinformatics, hyperspectral/UAV methods, multisensor data fusion, with the DJI Matrice 350 RTK platform, Zenmuse P1/L1/H20T sensors, Cubert ULTRIS 5 and CUVIS laboratory hyperspectral resources, ArcGIS/ENVI/MATLAB and open geospatial tools (GEE, QGIS, SNAP).

capacity_statements.heading: MATE - source scientific environment
capacity_statements.statement: Provides the 2022-2026 archive, experimental/irrigation knowledge and validation instruments: stomatal resistance/conductance equipment, SPAD chlorophyll meters, VIS-NIR (approx. 325-1075 nm) and VIS-NIR-SWIR (approx. 350-2500 nm) leaf spectroradiometers, soil-water measurements (TDR and capacitive sensors at 15 and 30 cm) and CWSI/thermal assessment tools where available.

capacity_statements.heading: Krumatic - associated non-academic partner
capacity_statements.statement: Bulgarian technology and digital-solutions company with software-implementation and systems-integration experience, including previous involvement in deployment of the AgroVIR farm-management platform in Bulgaria; provides the developer seat and Bulgarian uptake channel.

It must not be presented as a guaranteed second experiment.

training_and_career.statement: The fellowship provides end-to-end experience from multi-year scientific evidence, through leakage-safe modelling and independent commercial-field validation, to a web-accessible MVP and industrial assessment — a profile relevant to universities, European research organisations, precision-agriculture and irrigation-technology companies, EO/geospatial organisations, crop-phenotyping groups and FMIS providers.
The fellowship addresses the remaining competence gap: rigorous predictive modelling and model validation across time, sensing scales and environments.

Intended progression: from plant physiologist/agronomist using digital tools to an independent Agricultural Data Scientist specialised in plant stress, Earth observation and decision-support systems. FIELDWISE is a consolidation of an already established interdisciplinary trajectory, not a change of field.
